opportunity.title: Quick Content Creation Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small business owners and emerging content creators looking to enhance their online presence using short-form video.
opportunity.customer_problem: Many small businesses struggle to create engaging short-form video content that effectively promotes their products or services due to lack of time, skills, and resources.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Develop a 'Quick Content Creation Package' that includes tailored short-form video ideas, scripts, captions, and a brief social media strategy specific to platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
deliverables: 5 customized short-form video scripts (up to 60 seconds each)
5 engaging captions optimized for TikTok and Instagram
Basic social media strategy outline for video distribution
1 video content calendar for a month
opportunity.next_action: Prepare a free consultation form to understand the client's needs and goals.
